models_evaluated: fine-tuned GPT-4o-mini + RAG + finite state machine (FSM)

links.outcome: Expert preference between fine-tuned model with and without RAG grounding
links.effect: Model 2 (FT+RAG) did not differ from model 1 (FT only) in expert preference after Bonferroni correction; adding FSM (model 3) was preferred in 34/43 (79.1%) scenarios.
links.quote: Pairwise McNemar tests showed model 3 was preferred significantly more often than model 1 and model 2 (both P<.001), while model 1 versus model 2 did not differ after Bonferroni correction.

unlisted_practices: Finite state machine-guided dialogue control layered on RAG to enforce structured consultation logic in a patient-facing chatbot

screen.reason: The study conducts an ablation comparison testing whether adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and finite state machine (FSM) dialogue guardrails to a fine-tuned LLM improves clinical acceptability for patient queries.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation and dialogue state machine control
